summary: The agent provides a highly robust and sophisticated solution, properly handling isolation of test data and utilizing advanced feature engineering (target encoding, text embeddings) and ensembling (Nelder-Mead weight optimization). The primary flaws are structural inconsistencies in the cross-validation pipeline: fitting TF-IDF/SVD on the full training set (causing mild CV leakage) and fitting scalers/encoders on an unused 80% split (causing feature degradation during CV).
